t: Jakks Pacific - Wikipedia
s: January 1, 2026 - Jakks Pacific, Inc. is an American toy manufacturer founded in January 1995. The company is best known for producing licensed action figures, playsets, dolls, plush toys and dress-up sets. They are also well known for their line up of Plug-n-Play Television Game Consoles popularized in the 2000s.
